image_description: A close-up view of a brown pelican perched on a rocky surface. The bird has dark brown and grey plumage, a long neck, and a distinctive large bill with a gular pouch. A severe visual artifact resembling a melted or fused orange-and-white object (possibly a distorted flipper or wing fragment) protrudes from the left side of the bird's body.
